image_description: A bathroom scene featuring a toilet with the lid up. On the toilet seat sits a roll of toilet paper with a colorful, patterned wrapper or design on the side. To the left is a white wall-mounted fixture (likely a toilet paper holder or flush mechanism). Hanging from the top right are tattered, shredded strips of what appears to be toilet paper or wallpaper, creating a chaotic, messy aesthetic. The lighting is indoor and slightly dim.
